extensionName.description: Name of the pi extension to validate. The validator will look for `.pi/extensions/<extensionName>/smoke.ts` by default. Must be lowercase kebab-case (pi extension name convention).

scenarios.description: Optional override — inline Scenario JSON objects (matching harness/driver Scenario shape) to run instead of discovering smoke.ts on disk. Regex fields use the { source: string, flags?: string } wire shape; the Driver SDK hydrates them automatically.

piBinary.description: Path or name of the pi binary on PATH. Defaults to `pi`.

tmuxSession.description: Optional prefix override for the tmux session name. Defaults to `pij-<scenario.name>-<pid>` per Driver SDK convention.

cwd.description: Working directory for pi. Defaults to MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT (the pij repo root).
